title: Choose The Market
heading: Start with historical on-chain data
description: Select a parachain, protocol, and pool to pull the historical liquidity and pricing context behind each opportunity. ParaYield Lab focuses the workflow on data you can actually inspect.

title: Set The Assumptions
heading: Model the strategy you would actually run
description: Define token weights, capital size, fee tiers, and time range. Adjust slippage and XCM overhead so the simulation reflects the costs that shape real outcomes.

title: Run The Backtest
heading: Turn assumptions into a result
description: Execute the simulation to estimate fees earned, impermanent loss, and net performance from the exact setup you configured, without reducing everything to a single vanity metric.

title: Decide With Context
heading: Read the tradeoffs before you commit
description: Inspect the equity curve, compare yield against impermanent loss, and use the breakdown to decide whether to enter, skip, or refine the strategy.
